description: This file defines a NullFilter class for processing frames in a pipeline. It inherits from FrameProcessor and is designed to block all frames except system and end frames, primarily for testing or temporarily halting frame flow.

classes.name: NullFilter
classes.description: A frame processor that filters out all frames except system and end frames.

methods.name: __init__(self, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the NullFilter, passing additional arguments to the parent FrameProcessor.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes incoming frames; only system and end frames are forwarded, others are blocked.
